name: Ajvar
notes: Navedenih 1500 g je OČIŠĆENO pečeno meso crvene paprike (bez kore i semenki), ne bruto sveža paprika — inače bi se u zbir uračunalo ono što se baca. Kuvanjem se paprika svede na ~550 g, patlidžan 250→90 g; ulje, sirće i so ostaju. Prinos ~760 g, tj. ~10,5% ulja i ~1% soli u gotovom ajvaru. Vlakna (5,2 g/100 g) su deo ugljenih hidrata, ne dodatak na njih.
notesEn: The 1500 g above is CLEANED roasted red-pepper flesh (no skin or seeds), not raw whole peppers — otherwise the sum would include what gets thrown away. Cooking reduces the peppers to ~550 g and the aubergine from 250 to 90 g; the oil, vinegar and salt stay. Yield ~760 g, i.e. ~10.5% oil and ~1% salt in the finished ajvar. The fibre (5.2 g/100 g) is part of the carbohydrates, not an addition to them.

name: Baklava
notes: Tepsija za ~22 parčeta. Kore + orasi + puter (1200 g) → ~1080 g pečeno; sirup (450 g šećera, 350 g vode, limun) se ukuva na ~700 g i sav se upije. Prinos ~1780 g. Preko 400 kcal/100 g je tačno za baklavu — orasi i puter nose ~30% masti, a sirup ~44% ugljenih hidrata.
notesEn: A tray for ~22 pieces. Filo + walnuts + butter (1200 g) → ~1080 g baked; the syrup (450 g sugar, 350 g water, lemon) reduces to ~700 g and is fully absorbed. Yield ~1780 g. Above 400 kcal/100 g is correct for baklava — the walnuts and butter carry ~30% fat, and the syrup ~44% carbohydrate.

name: Bečka šnicla (pohovana teleća)
notes: Recept za 4 šnicle. Meso 600 g sirovo → 416 g pečenog (USDA odnos teletina sirovo→grilovano 0,693); panada 190 g → ~145 g; upijeno ulje 70 g (~11% gotove mase — tanka šnicla ima veću površinu po masi od debele). Prinos 631 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 4 schnitzels. 600 g raw meat → 416 g cooked (USDA raw veal → grilled ratio 0.693); 190 g breading → ~145 g; 70 g absorbed oil (~11% of the finished weight — a thin schnitzel has more surface per unit weight than a thick one). Yield 631 g.

name: Boranija sa mesom
notes: Recept za 7 porcija. Sirova masa 2688 g sa 1000 g vode; boranija se kuva do mekoće, isparavanje ~22% — ~2100 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 7 servings. 2688 g raw mass with 1000 g water; the beans cook until tender, evaporation ~22% — ~2100 g.

name: Burek sa mesom
notes: Tepsija za 5 porcija; koristi se mleveno juneće 90/10, kako se kod nas najčešće melje za burek. Sirova masa 1268 g; kore 500→440 g, meso 450→300 g (gubitak vode), luk 250→150 g, ulje 60 g ostaje — pečena masa ~950 g. Gustina od ~300 kcal/100 g je realna: kore su same po sebi 299 kcal/100 g.
notesEn: A tray for 5 servings; it uses 90/10 ground beef, the way burek mince is usually ground here. 1268 g raw mass; filo 500→440 g, meat 450→300 g (water loss), onion 250→150 g, the 60 g oil stays — baked mass ~950 g. A density of ~300 kcal/100 g is realistic: filo alone is 299 kcal/100 g.

name: Burek sa sirom
notes: Tepsija za 6 porcija. Beli sir je modelovan kao feta (najbliži javni zapis za salamureni beli sir) uz dodatak posnog mladog sira. Sirova masa 1380 g; pečenje odnese ~12% vlage — pečena masa ~1220 g.
notesEn: A tray for 6 servings. The white cheese is modelled as feta (the closest public record for brined white cheese) with some low-fat fresh cheese added. 1380 g raw mass; baking drives off ~12% moisture — baked mass ~1220 g.

name: Ćevapi
notes: Sirovi recept: 400 g mlevene junetine (80/20) + 300 g mlevene svinjetine + beli luk + so. Komponente su unete kao PEČENE, sa USDA odnosima sirovo→pečeno (junetina 0,667; svinjetina 0,700) — tako je otopljena mast koja iscuri sa roštilja već odbijena (USDA: pečena junetina zadržava ~59% masti). Zbir pečenih masa = prinos 491 g.
notesEn: Raw recipe: 400 g ground beef (80/20) + 300 g ground pork + garlic + salt. The components are entered as COOKED, with the USDA raw→cooked ratios (beef 0.667; pork 0.700) — so the fat that melts off the grill is already deducted (USDA: cooked beef retains ~59% of its fat). The cooked masses sum to a 491 g yield.

name: Đuveč pirinač (posni)
notes: Prilog za 6-7 porcija. Sirova masa 2028 g; pirinač upija oko 2,65× svoje suve mase (USDA sirov→kuvan pirinač), povrće se skuplja — gotova masa ~1650 g.
notesEn: A side dish for 6–7 servings. 2028 g raw mass; the rice absorbs about 2.65× its dry weight (USDA raw→cooked rice) and the vegetables shrink — finished mass ~1650 g.

name: Đuveč sa mesom
notes: Recept za 6 porcija. Sirova masa 2628 g sa 900 g vode; pirinač upija tečnost, povrće je pušta, neto isparavanje ~20% — pečena masa ~2100 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings. 2628 g raw mass with 900 g water; the rice absorbs liquid, the vegetables release it, net evaporation ~20% — baked mass ~2100 g.

name: Gibanica
notes: Tepsija za 8 porcija. Sirova masa 1680 g; pečenje ~45 min odnese ~14% vlage — pečena masa ~1450 g. Beli sir modelovan kao feta. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A tray for 8 servings. 1680 g raw mass; baking for ~45 min drives off ~14% moisture — baked mass ~1450 g. The white cheese is modelled as feta. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Grašak sa mesom
notes: Recept za 6 porcija. Sirova masa 2325 g sa 900 g vode; grašak upija deo tečnosti, neto isparavanje ~20% — ~1850 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings. 2325 g raw mass with 900 g water; the peas absorb some of the liquid, net evaporation ~20% — ~1850 g.

name: Gulaš od junetine
notes: Recept za 6 porcija. Sirova masa 2835 g sa 1200 g vode; meso i luk se dinstaju dok se sos potpuno ne zgusne — gulaš se služi gust, pa je isparavanje veliko, ~38% — gotova masa ~1750 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings. 2835 g raw mass with 1200 g water; the meat and onion stew until the sauce thickens completely — goulash is served thick, so evaporation is high, ~38% — finished mass ~1750 g.

name: Japrak (sarma od vinovog lista)
notes: Recept za 5 porcija. Koristi se svež vinov list (USDA 'Grape leaves, raw'); so je zasebna stavka jer je konzervisani list u salamuri prekomerno slan. Sirova masa 1831 g, krčkanje ~1,5 h — kuvana masa ~1400 g (~24% isparavanja).
notesEn: A recipe for 5 servings. Fresh vine leaves are used (USDA 'Grape leaves, raw'); salt is a separate item because brined canned leaves are excessively salty. 1831 g raw mass, ~1.5 h simmering — cooked mass ~1400 g (~24% evaporation).

name: Kačamak sa sirom
notes: Recept za 4-5 porcija. Kukuruzno brašno se kuva u vodi ~20 min; sirova masa 1568 g, isparavanje ~14% — gotova masa ~1350 g. Umesto kajmaka (nema javnog zapisa o sastavu) umešani su puter i beli sir.
notesEn: A recipe for 4–5 servings. The corn flour is cooked in water for ~20 min; 1568 g raw mass, evaporation ~14% — finished mass ~1350 g. Instead of kajmak (no public record of its composition), butter and white cheese are mixed in.

name: Karađorđeva šnicla
notes: Recept za 3 šnicle. Punjenje je kačkavalj + kisela pavlaka: varijanta sa kajmakom NIJE derivirana jer za kajmak ne postoji javno dostupna tabela sastava. Meso 500 g → 346 g (USDA 0,693); pavlaka 60 → ~50 g; panada 200 → ~150 g; upijeno ulje 80 g (~11%). Prinos 746 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 3 schnitzels. The filling is kačkavalj and sour cream: the kajmak variant is NOT derived because no publicly available composition table exists for kajmak. Meat 500 g → 346 g (USDA 0.693); sour cream 60 → ~50 g; breading 200 → ~150 g; absorbed oil 80 g (~11%). Yield 746 g.

name: Krempita
notes: Tepsija za 12 parčadi. Lisnato testo 300 g → 240 g pečeno; krema (mleko, jaja, šećer, gustin, puter = 1450 g) kuvanjem izgubi ~100 g vode → 1350 g; šlag 200 g (mućenjem se dodaje vazduh, ne masa). Prinos 1790 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25%, Slatka pavlaka za šlag (36%) objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A tray for 12 slices. Puff pastry 300 g → 240 g baked; the custard (milk, eggs, sugar, cornflour, butter = 1450 g) loses ~100 g of water while cooking → 1350 g; 200 g cream (whipping adds air, not mass). Yield 1790 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25%, and whipping cream (36%) publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Krofne
notes: 15 krofni. Testo 980 g; prženjem gubi ~90 g vode i upija ulje. Maseni bilans: ulje je ~15% gotove mase (tipično za dizano testo prženo u dubokom ulju), pa x = 890/(1-0,15) = 1047 g i upijeno ulje 157 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: 15 doughnuts. 980 g dough; frying loses ~90 g of water and absorbs oil. Mass balance: the oil is ~15% of the finished mass (typical for risen dough fried in deep oil), so x = 890/(1−0.15) = 1047 g and the absorbed oil is 157 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Krompir paprikaš
notes: Recept za 7 porcija. Sirova masa 3210 g sa 1400 g vode; krompir upija sos, isparavanje ~22% — ~2500 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 7 servings. 3210 g raw mass with 1400 g water; the potato absorbs the sauce, evaporation ~22% — ~2500 g.

name: Kupus salata
notes: Bez termičke obrade. Kupus posoljen pusti vodu koja ostaje u salati, pa je prinos jednak zbiru sastojaka (861 g).
notesEn: No cooking. Salted cabbage releases water that stays in the salad, so the yield equals the sum of the ingredients (861 g).

name: Mućkalica
notes: Recept za 5-6 porcija. Sirova masa 2240 g; meso i povrće se dugo dinstaju u otvorenoj tavi, isparavanje ~29% — ~1600 g. Mast iz mesa ostaje u jelu.
notesEn: A recipe for 5–6 servings. 2240 g raw mass; the meat and vegetables stew for a long time in an open pan, evaporation ~29% — ~1600 g. The fat from the meat stays in the dish.

name: Musaka od plavog patlidžana
notes: Recept za 6 porcija. Patlidžan se prethodno prži i upija celokupnih 80 g ulja (zato je ulja više nego u krompir-musaki). Sirova masa 2218 g, pečenje odnese ~19% vlage — ~1800 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings. The aubergine is fried first and absorbs all 80 g of the oil (which is why there is more oil than in the potato moussaka). 2218 g raw mass, baking drives off ~19% moisture — ~1800 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Musaka sa krompirom
notes: Klasična tepsija za 6 porcija. Sirova masa 2308 g; pečenje ~60 min u rerni odnese ~15% vlage — pečena masa ~1960 g. Meso se ne cedi, mast ostaje u jelu. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A classic tray for 6 servings. 2308 g raw mass; baking for ~60 min drives off ~15% moisture — baked mass ~1960 g. The meat is not drained, so the fat stays in the dish. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Palačinke sa džemom
notes: 12 palačinki. Testo 923 g gubi ~15% vode pri pečenju i zadržava ~20 g ulja iz tiganja (ostatak od 50 g ostane u tiganju — ali je ovde ceo iskazan, pa je vrednost blago konzervativna); pečene palačinke ~787 g + 240 g džema = 1027 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: 12 pancakes. The 923 g batter loses ~15% water during frying and retains ~20 g of oil from the pan (the rest of the 50 g stays in the pan — but the whole amount is stated here, so the figure is slightly conservative); cooked pancakes ~787 g + 240 g jam = 1027 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Palačinke sa krem namazom

recipe.what: Krem namaz od lešnika i kakaa (Eurokrem tip)

notes: Isto testo kao kod palačinki sa džemom (pečene ~787 g) + 200 g krem namaza od lešnika i kakaa (generički, Eurokrem tip) = 987 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: The same batter as the jam pancakes (cooked ~787 g) + 200 g hazelnut-and-cocoa spread (generic, Eurokrem type) = 987 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Pasulj sa mesom (čorbast)
notes: Čorbast pasulj za 7 porcija. Sirova masa 3288 g sa 2200 g vode; pasulj upija vodu (2,4× suve mase), a dugo krčkanje odnese ~21% ukupne mase — ~2600 g. Vlakna (2,7 g/100 g) su sadržana u ugljenim hidratima, ne dodaju se na njih. Izvor za Slanina, sirova objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A soupy bean stew for 7 servings. 3288 g raw mass with 2200 g water; the beans absorb water (2.4× their dry weight) and the long simmer drives off ~21% of the total mass — ~2600 g. The fibre (2.7 g/100 g) is contained in the carbohydrates, not added to them. The source for Bacon, raw publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Pečena piletina (batak)

recipe.what: Pileći batak, meso i koža, pečen

notes: Sirovo: ~905 g pilećih bataka sa kožom; uneti kao pečeni (USDA odnos 0,774 → 700 g). Prinos 726 g. Otopljena mast koja iscuri u tepsiju nije uračunata jer USDA vrednost za pečen batak već to odražava.
notesEn: Raw: ~905 g chicken drumsticks with skin; entered as roasted (USDA ratio 0.774 → 700 g). Yield 726 g. The melted fat that runs into the tray is not counted because the USDA value for a roast drumstick already reflects it.

name: Pečena riba (šaran)
notes: Sirovo ~770 g šarana → 600 g pečenog (USDA odnos sirovo→pečeno 0,78, izveden iz sadržaja proteina u paru sirov/pečen šaran). Ulje i limun se dodaju pri pečenju. Prinos 651 g.
notesEn: Raw ~770 g carp → 600 g roasted (USDA raw→cooked ratio 0.78, derived from the protein content of the raw/cooked carp pair). The oil and lemon are added during roasting. Yield 651 g.

name: Pečene paprike u ulju
notes: Navedenih 1000 g je očišćeno pečeno meso paprike (bez kore i semenki). Pečenjem se svede na ~600 g; ulje, sirće i beli luk se dodaju posle. Prinos ~705 g.
notesEn: The 1000 g stated is cleaned roasted pepper flesh (no skin or seeds). Roasting reduces it to ~600 g; the oil, vinegar and garlic are added afterwards. Yield ~705 g.

name: Pileća čorba (supa sa rezancima)
notes: Supa za 10 porcija. Sirova masa 3980 g sa 3000 g vode; rezanci upijaju vodu, kuvanje odnese ~20% — ~3200 g. Niska gustina je realna za bistru supu.
notesEn: A soup for 10 servings. 3980 g raw mass with 3000 g water; the noodles absorb water and cooking drives off ~20% — ~3200 g. A low density is correct for a clear soup.

name: Pileći paprikaš

recipe.what: Pileći batak, meso i koža, sirov

notes: Recept za 6 porcija sa bataцима (meso i koža). Sirova masa 2762 g; krčkanje ~50 min i zaprška od pavlake, isparavanje ~28% — ~2000 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings with drumsticks (meat and skin). 2762 g raw mass; ~50 min simmering and a cream liaison, evaporation ~28% — ~2000 g.

name: Pinđur
notes: Kao i kod ajvara, paprika je iskazana kao očišćeno pečeno meso. Kuvanjem: paprika 1000→370 g, patlidžan 500→180 g, paradajz 400→120 g; ulje i začini ostaju. Prinos ~763 g.
notesEn: As with ajvar, the peppers are stated as cleaned roasted flesh. Cooking: peppers 1000→370 g, aubergine 500→180 g, tomato 400→120 g; the oil and spices stay. Yield ~763 g.

name: Pita sa krompirom (krompiruša)
notes: Tepsija za 6-7 porcija. Sirova masa 1640 g; kore 450→400 g, krompir 900→720 g, luk 200→120 g, ulje 80 g ostaje — pečena masa ~1320 g (~20% gubitka).
notesEn: A tray for 6–7 servings. 1640 g raw mass; filo 450→400 g, potato 900→720 g, onion 200→120 g, the 80 g oil stays — baked mass ~1320 g (~20% loss).

name: Pita zeljanica
notes: Tepsija za 6 porcija. Spanać drastično gubi vodu (700 g sirovog → ~180 g u piti); kore 450→400 g, jaja 100→85 g, pavlaka 100→85 g, ulje ostaje. Sirova masa 1670 g → pečena ~1162 g (~30% gubitka, gotovo sve iz spanaća). So se ne dodaje — kore i beli sir je unose dovoljno.
notesEn: A tray for 6 servings. Spinach loses water dramatically (700 g raw → ~180 g in the pie); filo 450→400 g, eggs 100→85 g, sour cream 100→85 g, the oil stays. 1670 g raw → ~1162 g baked (~30% loss, almost all of it from the spinach). No salt is added — the filo and white cheese already carry enough.

name: Pljeskavica
notes: Sirovi recept: 500 g mlevene junetine (80/20) + 300 g svinjetine + 100 g luka + so; meso je uneto pečeno (USDA odnosi 0,667 i 0,700), pa je iscurela mast odbijena. Luk je sirov i gubi samo vodu: 100 g → ~60 g. Prinos 334+210+60+8 = 612 g.
notesEn: Raw recipe: 500 g ground beef (80/20) + 300 g pork + 100 g onion + salt; the meat is entered cooked (USDA ratios 0.667 and 0.700), so the fat that ran out is deducted. The onion is raw and loses only water: 100 g → ~60 g. Yield 334+210+60+8 = 612 g.

name: Pljeskavica u lepinji
notes: Lepinja je modelovana belim hlebom (najbliži javni zapis). Pljeskavica: 250 g juneće + 150 g svinjske mlevene sirovine, uneto kao pečeno po USDA odnosima (0,667 i 0,700); luk 50→30 g. Prinos 485 g.
notesEn: The flatbread is modelled as white bread (the closest public record). The patty: 250 g beef + 150 g ground pork, entered as cooked by the USDA ratios (0.667 and 0.700); onion 50→30 g. Yield 485 g.

name: Podvarak sa mesom
notes: Recept za 6 porcija. Sirova masa 2620 g; podvarak se peče otkriven pa je isparavanje veće nego kod sarme, ~27% — pečena masa ~1900 g. So se ne dodaje, kiseli kupus i kobasica je unose.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 servings. 2620 g raw mass; podvarak is baked uncovered so evaporation is higher than for sarma, ~27% — baked mass ~1900 g. No salt is added; the sauerkraut and sausage carry enough.

name: Pohovani kačkavalj
notes: Recept za 6 parčadi. Sir se topi ali ne gubi masu; panada 190 g → ~145 g; upijeno ulje 60 g (~8,5% gotove mase — panada oko sira upija manje od mesne jer se prži kratko). Prinos 705 g. Gustina od ~400 kcal/100 g je stvarna za pohovan punomasni sir.
notesEn: A recipe for 6 pieces. The cheese melts but does not lose mass; 190 g breading → ~145 g; 60 g absorbed oil (~8.5% of the finished mass — the breading around cheese absorbs less than a meat one because it fries briefly). Yield 705 g. A density of ~400 kcal/100 g is real for breaded full-fat cheese.

name: Pohovano pileće belo meso

recipe.what: Pileće belo meso bez kože, sirovo

notes: Recept za 4 šnicle. Navedene su količine panade koje se ZAISTA zalepe za meso (od ~40 g brašna, 100 g jaja i 120 g prezli otpada ~25%). Meso 600 g sirovo → 436 g pečenog (USDA odnos 0,726), panada 190 g → ~145 g. Upijeno ulje 65 g = ~10% gotove mase, što je uobičajeno za pohovano meso u dubokom ulju. Prinos 436+145+65 = 646 g.
notesEn: A recipe for 4 schnitzels. The breading quantities given are what ACTUALLY sticks to the meat (of ~40 g flour, 100 g egg and 120 g breadcrumbs, ~25% is left over). 600 g raw meat → 436 g cooked (USDA ratio 0.726), 190 g breading → ~145 g. 65 g absorbed oil = ~10% of the finished mass, which is usual for breaded meat in deep oil. Yield 436+145+65 = 646 g.

name: Pomfrit (prženi krompir)
notes: 1 kg sirovog krompira. Maseni bilans: suva materija krompira ~207 g je konstantna; u gotovom pomfritu voda pada na ~40% mase a mast je ~15%, odakle x = 207/(1-0,40-0,15) = 460 g gotovog i 69 g upijenog ulja. Prinos 46% od sirovog krompira odgovara industrijskom randmanu svežeg pomfrita.
notesEn: 1 kg raw potato. Mass balance: the potato's dry matter, ~207 g, is constant; in the finished chips water drops to ~40% of the mass and fat is ~15%, so x = 207/(1−0.40−0.15) = 460 g finished and 69 g absorbed oil. A 46% yield from raw potato matches the industrial yield of fresh chips.

name: Popara
notes: Recept za 3 porcije. Hleb se prelije vrelim mlekom i kratko krčka; sirova masa 1064 g, isparavanje ~11% — gotova masa ~950 g. Izvor za Mleko, punomasno 3,25% objavljuje šećere iznad ukupnih ugljenih hidrata (UH se računaju po razlici, šećer se meri direktno); šećer sastojka je spušten na UH, a šećer jela preračunat iz ispravljenog recepta.
notesEn: A recipe for 3 servings. The bread is covered with hot milk and simmered briefly; 1064 g raw mass, evaporation ~11% — finished mass ~950 g. The source for Milk, whole 3.25% publishes sugars above total carbohydrates (carbohydrates are counted by difference, sugar is measured directly); the ingredient's sugar was lowered to the carbohydrate figure, and the dish's sugar was recalculated from the corrected recipe.

name: Prebranac (pasulj iz rerne)
notes: Recept za 7 porcija. Suv pasulj daje 2,4× kuvane mase (USDA sirov→kuvan beli pasulj = 2,405×), pa 500 g suvog → ~1200 g kuvanog; luk se prepolovi pečenjem. Sirova masa sa vodom 2740 g → pečena masa ~1700 g. Vlakna (5,4 g/100 g) su deo ugljenih hidrata, ne dodatak na njih — kako ih USDA i vodi.

source.basis: Odluka osnivača (2026-08-01): mast postavljena na 50%, sredina objavljenog raspona za mladi kajmak. Belančevine (~6 g) i laktoza (~1,5 g) prate taj nivo masti, ostatak je voda, a energija je izračunata po Atwateru iz te tri vrednosti — nije je niko objavio.
source.range: Mladi kajmak 40–55% masti, zreo 60–70%. Pravilnik propisuje samo donje granice, pa jedan broj ne može da opiše sve što se prodaje pod ovim imenom.

notes: Sadržaj masti je POSTAVLJENA vrednost, ne merenje: kajmak varira 40–55% masti kad je mlad i 60–70% kad je zreo, a nijedan javni izvor ga ne meri. Broj je sredina raspona za mladi kajmak. Ako meriš svoj, unesi ga kao sopstvenu namirnicu — biće tačniji od svakog proseka.
notesEn: The fat content is a SET value, not a measurement: kajmak ranges from 40–55% fat when young to 60–70% when mature, and no public source measures it. The figure is the midpoint of the range for young kajmak. If you weigh your own, enter it as your own food — it will be more accurate than any average.

notesEn: The 4P+4C+9F sum is higher than the kcal figure because USDA counts carbohydrates "by difference" (including fibre and organic acids) and derives energy with food-specific Atwater factors. The published kcal value is authoritative and has not been adjusted.

name: Brašno, raženo, tamno
notes: USDA za ovu namirnicu koristi sopstvene Atwater faktore 2.96/8.37/3.78 (belančevine/masti/ugljeni hidrati) umesto opštih 4/9/4; s njima je energija 325 kcal, što odgovara objavljenih 325 kcal. Opšti obrazac 4P+4UH+9M daje 358 kcal i zato odstupa 10%.
notesEn: USDA uses its own Atwater factors for this food (protein 2.96, fat 8.37, carbohydrate 3.78) rather than the general 4/9/4; with them the energy is 325 kcal, which matches the published 325 kcal. The general 4P+4C+9F formula gives 358 kcal, a 10% deviation.
